title: Two New Luxury Homes! Hot Tub + Game Room!
description:
Two brand new homes!

The space
BRAND NEW LISTING! Two beautiful homes are located in the heart of Nashville, less than a 10 minute Uber to Broadway! This area is filled with a ton of great restaurants and home to many of Nashville's recording studios. This large home offers plenty of space and LOTS of beds for your group!  The bed options range from cozy kings and queens to sofa sleepers and daybeds with trundles. To top it off, these homes have a hot tub on the roof top and game room to make your stay even more enjoyable!

- Capacity: 16+ guests
- Bedrooms: 8 total, with a mix of queen, king, single, trundle, and sleeper beds
- Bathrooms: 8 full bathrooms

Amenities:
- Shared amenities including a pool, sauna, firepit, and grill.
- POOL is SEASONAL from April 1 - October 15
- Fully equipped kitchens with cookware, coffee maker, wine glasses, and storage containers
- Washer & dryer with detergent provided
- Towels, linens, iron & board, hair dryer
- Wi-Fi and cable TV
- Air conditioning

This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1500 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $89 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $2 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional.

To make this process easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account - it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

If you have any questions, just message us anytime! Happy to help!
